# Cringe deadpan AI characters for the "is he real?" influencer format

**A bizarre but believable adult in a wrong suit becomes a character sheet plus a one-action-every-post format.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_6b9b9732cba6.webp" alt="A deadpan character sheet of a slim man with a bowl haircut, tinted glasses and a mustard three-piece suit, panning from full body to his face." width="480"></p>

Makes cringe, deadpan, odd-looking AI characters people argue about, on varg: a photoreal, bizarre-but-believable person (strange haircut, wrong suit, absurd shoes) who takes himself completely seriously and repeats one action in a new place every post: the "Jean Phil" format of late 2026. Builds the character sheet and the posting format. Use when someone asks for a weird, cringe, odd, awkward or deadpan character, a strange AI influencer, a "is he real?" persona, or a character like Jean Phil. Part of varg-character-design (definition, sheet, reuse in video).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-character-cringe                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-character-cringe --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 73 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|

- "Create a deadpan AI influencer: a 55-year-old man with a blonde bob in a mustard corduroy suit"
- "Make a weird "is he real?" character who power-walks through a new ordinary place in every post"
- "Build a cringe character sheet and a posting plan for a new faceless Instagram account"
